title: The Flow track - one umbrella over authoring shape, the LTX v2v trio, Flows v2 and community packages
description:
UMBRELLA created 2026-08-14, MERGED TWICE on 2026-08-16 at Fabio's request. First merge: MPI-529 (Flow Library v2) and MPI-552 (LTX 2.3 v2v trio) were deleted into this card. Second merge: MPI-530 (character consistency at the bench) was deleted into it too, so every Flow-related card lives in one place. One Flow track, six phases, nine members: MPI-332 (rip the 3 test flows), MPI-531 (1.5 authoring shape - RELEASE BLOCKER, item 1 landed), MPI-536 + MPI-520 (shipped, validating) + MPI-538 (LTX v2v trio), MPI-504 + MPI-348 (the BENCH track - character sheet then the Krea2 swap family, from MPI-530), MPI-259 (Flows v2 deferred paths), MPI-532 (1.6 community packages).

They were one track split four ways: every app-side card ends up editing js/data/flowsRegistry.js, and every one was gated on the same FlowStepField work. THE ONE IDEA: uiComponent names a JS component a third party can never have, so the 1.5 authoring shape IS the 1.6 package format, paid a release early where it is cheap. Keep the port surface at ONE component (MpiFlowHeadSwap).

PHASE 4 IS BENCH WORK, NOT APP WIRING - MPI-504 and MPI-348 are authored by Fabio in the ComfyUI node graph, own no js/ file and are NOT dispatchable to a worker sub-agent. A Flow outcome discovered there gets its own member card and goes through /mpi-add-flow, exactly as the LTX trio did after MPI-537.

Members, phase order, settled decisions and all three deleted plans' drift notes: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md.
